title: festuca duriuscula var. caesia
intro: Festuca duriuscula var. caesia, commonly known as Alpine Fescue, is a type of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects, making it useful in treating various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of Festuca duriuscula var. caesia include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites, although further research is needed to fully understand its chemical composition.
